Name: Custom Chest Types
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This mod is a framework that allows you to create container objects (chests) that look like anything you want them to, including custom opening animations

All containers will be available for purchase at Robin's store. You can also spawn them in with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB Item Spawner[/url]﻿.

As these objects are chests, they are picked up as chests are, by hitting them with a tool when they are empty.

There is a sample content pack in the optional files with three custom containers:

[list]
[*]A bedside table
[*]A bookshelf
[*]A safe
[/list]
Explanation on how to create your own custom containers is [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/615]here[/url].


Known issues:

[list]
[*]When the container is removed it appears invisible as it floats towards the player
[*]Container capacity over three rows or 12 items per row causes overlap issues with other UI elements - please add the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7431]Expanded Storage[/url]﻿ mod to fix this
[*]Only clicking on the bottom left area of the object opens the container
[/list]

Thanks to furyx639 for adding in opening animations and for their work to make [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7431]Expanded Storage[/url] compatible with this mod!


[size=5][b]Technical:[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url], uses Harmony.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338]Mod Updater[/url]﻿ for automatic updates.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].
